full_judgment: 31. On perusal of the judgment of the appellate Court and trial Court below as well it appears that trial Court had considered the material evidence in detail in coming to its finding of title and possession in favour of the plaintiffs, but the appellate Court, without discussing the evidence, had abruptly reversed the findings of fact arrived at by the trial Court on the point of maintainability of the suit. Thus it appears that the impugned judgment of the appellate Court was not a proper judgment of reversal.
